description: This file contains unit tests for the JpegSizeLimiter class, verifying its behavior when compressing images to fit within size limits and when keeping small payloads unchanged.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterTest
classes.description: Test class for the JpegSizeLimiter, containing tests for compression limits and payload sizes.

methods.name: compressesLargePayloadsUnderLimit
methods.description: Test method to verify that large images are compressed to not exceed the maximum byte size.

methods.name: keepsSmallPayloadsAsIs
methods.description: Test method to verify that small images are not altered during compression, retaining original dimensions and quality.
